scientific_question: Can structure predict the confirmed wild-type AID720551 fixed-dose FluxOR call?
eligible_training_data: Only conflict-free conclusive AID720551 parent structures; no mutants
frozen_test_design: Current scaffold groups plus a harder maximum-Tanimoto exclusion set; retain natural 0.365% prevalence
required_baselines: prevalence/no-skill; logistic-ECFP4; RF-ECFP4; XGBoost-ECFP4; D-MPNN; AttentiveFP
secondary_metrics: ROC-AUC; MCC; balanced accuracy; recall; specificity; Brier; ECE; EF0.1%; EF1%; precision at fixed review budgets
superiority_rule: paired scaffold-cluster bootstrap 95% CI for PR-AUC difference above 0 against the strongest tuned baseline, calibration noninferior, and no material recall loss; confirm across 5 seeds
failure_prevented: accuracy/AUROC inflation under extreme imbalance and random-split analog leakage

scientific_question: Can structure predict exact wild-type-or-unspecified functional IC50?
eligible_training_data: Exact positive functional IC50 in nM/uM; preserve replicate, cell, protocol, source and censoring; exclude mutants
frozen_test_design: parent-structure/scaffold split plus source and temporal holdouts; report assay modality separately
required_baselines: median; RF-ECFP4; XGBoost-ECFP4; SVM-ECFP4; D-MPNN; Pred-hERG-style open reproduction; hERGBoost only if frozen runnable artifact acquired
secondary_metrics: RMSE; Spearman; R2; within 3-fold and 10-fold IC50; calibration/coverage; censored likelihood where applicable
superiority_rule: paired bootstrap 95% CI for MAE improvement below 0 and no degradation on source/modality holdouts
failure_prevented: pooling binding Ki, flux AC50, fixed-dose calls, and IC50 into a fictitious numeric endpoint

scientific_question: Does measurement technology change labels or model transport?
eligible_training_data: Rows with resolved manual patch, automated patch, flux/fluorescence, radioligand binding, or unresolved modality
frozen_test_design: leave-one-modality-out and matched-structure cross-modality evaluation; never call binding or flux patch clamp
required_baselines: same molecular baselines with and without modality token; assay-specific heads; hierarchical multitask head
secondary_metrics: cross-modality calibration; paired label disagreement; Bland-Altman for paired pIC50; interaction effect with CI
superiority_rule: assay-aware model must improve at least two resolved modalities without degrading direct patch-clamp performance; otherwise retain separate models
failure_prevented: source confounding and the false claim that automated, manual, flux, and binding measurements are interchangeable

scientific_question: Does training on different evidence quality levels change generalization?
eligible_training_data: Frozen nonoverlapping quality strata derived before model fitting
frozen_test_design: same external test panels for all quality-specific models; a second size-matched experiment isolates quality from sample size
required_baselines: same architecture trained on each level; pooled model; curriculum/pretrain-finetune model
secondary_metrics: learning curves; calibration; disagreement; coverage; effective sample size
superiority_rule: claim a quality effect only when size-matched and full-data analyses agree with uncertainty intervals
failure_prevented: confounding data quality with dataset size or model architecture

scientific_question: Does performance survive a genuinely new source or later chemistry?
frozen_test_design: leave-source-out and chronological holdout; remove exact parent, same scaffold, and near neighbors according to preregistered thresholds
required_baselines: all open baselines and frozen competitor inference where legally/runnably available
primary_metric: PR-AUC for classification; MAE for pIC50
superiority_rule: no superiority claim unless direction holds on both source and time holdouts
failure_prevented: reusing the same public records under different database wrappers as external validation

scientific_question: Does predicted hERG liability add information about clinical QT/QTc after exposure?
eligible_training_data: hERG predictions are inputs; clinical QT records are never relabeled as hERG assays
frozen_test_design: drug-level trial/regulatory holdout with molecule, dose, arm, time, QT correction, exposure and result provenance
required_baselines: exposure-only; structure-only; hERG-only; hERG plus free Cmax; multichannel/PK model when available
primary_metric: continuous delta-delta-QTcF error or concentration-QTc slope error, task dependent
secondary_metrics: AUROC/AUPRC for thresholded QT signal; calibration; incremental likelihood; decision curve
superiority_rule: hERG model must add preregistered incremental value over exposure/clinical covariates on a held-out drug set; describe as translation, not proof of causality
failure_prevented: conflating molecular hERG block with QT prolongation, torsade de pointes, or general cardiotoxicity
